text: is it possible to do it where i could select one vert and one edge, and it would share that vert with one of the extended edges and leave the other one open to connect to
resolution: Extended the same native edge extrusion to consume one retained edge plus one Shift-selected same-part vertex. The selected vertex is reused as an outer corner, only the opposite corner is minted, and the resulting open edge stays selected; choosing a source endpoint produces a triangle fan while choosing another vertex produces a quad bridge. Added contextual UI discovery, native selection/geometry regressions, and a green ReleaseFast build; user visual and spikewatch confirmation remain.
